header.title: AI Job Description Generator
header.subtitle: Generate three variants and pick the best — the recruiter keeps the final say.

toasts.invalidDescription: Job title and at least one skill are required.
toasts.errorDescription: Try again or adjust the input.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: Tell the AI which role you want to fill.
basics.skillsHint: Press Enter or comma to add.

requirements.title: Requirements and nice-to-haves
requirements.mustPlaceholder:
5+ years of React experience
Strong TypeScript skills
requirements.nicePlaceholder:
Experience with Next.js App Router
Web performance knowledge

style.title: Style and context
style.contextPlaceholder: Who are you? What do you do? What does the team look like?

aiInfo.title: What does the AI do?
aiInfo.body: The generator writes three variants with the same content, but in a different tone and structure. You pick one winner, can regenerate any variant, and edit it yourself before publishing.
aiInfo.disclosure: EU AI Act Art. 50 — the recruiter keeps the final say.

tips.title: Tips for the best result
tips.tip2: Mention team size and working model in the context.
tips.tip3: Add at least 3 skills for usable output.
tips.tip4: Tone "direct" works best for tech roles.

toasts.selectedDescription: You can now edit and publish it.
toasts.regeneratedDescription: A new version has been generated.

compare.aiBadgeLabel: Three AI-generated variants — the recruiter keeps the final say.
compare.aiHint: Generated by AI — pick or edit manually.

toasts.createdDraft: "{{title}}" is saved as a draft in your list.

publish.noVariant: First select a variant in step 2.
publish.editDescription: The AI output is a starting point — fine-tune as you like.

details.title: Job details
details.description: Operational fields the AI does not fill in.
details.criteriaPlaceholder: E.g. grading based on experience, collective-agreement scale 8-10, annual review cycle…
details.criteriaHint: Describe how compensation is determined — candidates see this on the job (EU directive 2023/970).

publish.payWarning: Setting it live directly requires a complete salary band (minimum and maximum) — mandatory under the EU pay transparency directive (2023/970). Fill in the band or choose “Save as draft”.
